question: Rule-fit coding of the full processor complaint set: apply the explanation_fit codes (full / partial / not explained / contradicted / unverified) from processor-disbursement-rules-2026-11-19.csv to all 2021+ processor records in the main corpus, not only the 2026-11-19 additions, and report the share of grant-delay complaints a written rule explains
